answer: Pair strangers for a live cross-examination: each epoch, every identity faces 3 random peers and must answer 5 fresh questions inside a 4-minute window, trading one cipher per round. One operator cannot hold 100 live dialogues at once, so clones stall and miss their slot. Two missed windows in a row voids the identity, the onyx ledger publishes every failure, and each clean epoch earns a pearl stamp toward full standing.
